content.what_it_is: Fortran wavemaker implementation containing initialization and dispatch for regular, time-series, measured-spectrum, TMA/JONSWAP, left-boundary, periodic, and 2021 coherence-aware wavemakers (lines 57-66, 75-523); dispersion/source-strength and directional-spectrum builders (lines 528-701, 1003-2187, 2327-2681); spatial cosine/sine coefficient assembly for elevation and velocity forcing (lines 705-887, 2692-2780); periodic-angle quantization (lines 892-985); wavemaker-zone viscosity and left-boundary state forcing (lines 2192-2316); and frequency relocation for partial coherence (lines 2791-2898). Initialization reads optional phases and spectra, filters components, allocates global forcing arrays, invokes the selected generator, and precomputes Cm/Sm fields (lines 166-371, 382-518).

unresolved: Several error paths say STOP or diagnose invalid input but call MPI_FINALIZE without STOP, RETURN, or control transfer: zero depth/period at lines 102-105 and infeasible periodic-angle searches at lines 117-128 and 137-147 continue into later wavemaker logic after MPI has been finalized; CalcPeriodicTheta likewise finalizes at line 912 and continues at line 915. The initial period guard is additionally too late because 2*pi/Tperiod is already evaluated at line 98.

WK_DATA2D filters directions and compacts Dire and WAVE_COMP at lines 203-242, but never compacts Phase2D before using Phase2D(J,I) at lines 255-282. When rejected directions are interspersed, input phases remain indexed by original direction while amplitudes and directions use compacted indices.

In WK_NEW_DATA2D, an END condition on phase input at line 403 jumps directly to label 1100 at line 413, bypassing CLOSE(1) at line 405; the optional-phase-absent path leaks the open unit. The older WK_TIME path opens unit 1 at line 301 and has no corresponding close before its branch ends at line 314.

Initialization sets NumDir=2 at line 388 but allocates and passes measured-spectrum arrays with second extent 1 at lines 390-392 and 430-475; the called new generator explicitly declares those arrays (NumFreq,1) at lines 2340-2346 and CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm ignores mtheta while declaring fixed second extent 1 at lines 2705-2709. The count interface and actual array shape therefore disagree and rely on the current implementations never indexing direction 2.

The WK_NEW_IRR one-direction branch initializes only theta(1) and AG(1) at lines 2522-2524, although both arrays have mfreq elements and later every AG(kf) and theta(kf) is consumed at lines 2558-2581 and 2602-2670. For mfreq greater than one this is direct use-before-assignment.

WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE declares displace_theta with extent mfreq at line 2505 but assigns the one-element result of MINLOC to the whole array at line 2526. Except when mfreq=1, the intrinsic assignment is shape-nonconforming even though only displace_theta(1) is subsequently used at line 2527.

phi1 is INTENT(OUT) at line 2498 but assigned at line 2653 only inside IF(PERIODIC), lines 2603-2663. The nonperiodic WK_NEW_IRR path returns phase_ir undefined and CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm immediately consumes it through the calls at lines 504-510 and the expressions at lines 2742-2773.

Three irregular generators recompute peak-frequency omgn, tb, tc, and wkn at lines 1833-1836, 2059-2062, and 2675-2678, but then compute width from wave_length left over from the last component loop at lines 1837, 2063, and 2679. The recomputed peak wavenumber is unused, so width depends on the last component rather than the declared peak frequency.

Zero-period checks in WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE and WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES are ineffective because division by Tperiod occurs first at lines 2096 and 2150, before checks at lines 2100 and 2156. Other unguarded singular operations include 1/PeakPeriod at lines 278 and 472, df=(fmax-fmin)/(mfreq-1) at lines 1358, 1886, and 2511, 20/sigma_theta at lines 1118, 1390, 1676, 1914, and 2520, and Newton division by Fkdif at line 807.

The equal-energy frequency repair reads Freq(kff-1) when kff can be 1 at lines 1101-1104 and 1662-1665, and compares Freq(mfreq-1) without requiring mfreq>1 at lines 1112-1113 and 1669-1671. The equal-dfrequency routines separately divide by mfreq-1, so no branch safely supports mfreq=1 despite explicit mtheta==1 handling elsewhere.

SHOW_BREAKING in the WK_DATA2D branch indexes WAVE_COMP(NumWaveComp,1) at lines 284-286 although that array is allocated with first extent NumFreq at lines 169-171; no relation between NumWaveComp and NumFreq is established in this branch. The new-data branch assigns T_brk=Freq(FreqCount) at lines 477-479, a frequency, while other branches assign periods such as 1/FreqMax at lines 349-350 and 514-515, indicating a unit/interface inconsistency.

WAVE_COHERENCE can build an empty host list when idx_theta=0 and mtheta>mfreq, then indexes host_freqs_idx(0) at line 2829. It can also build an empty candidate pool, notably mtheta=1 where every frequency is a host, yet a positive coherence request enters lines 2859-2863; mfreq_temp is then zero and CEILING(rand(0)*mfreq_temp) produces index 0. Even with a nonempty pool, a random value exactly zero makes candidate_freq_idx zero at line 2861.

The dispersion/Newton and source-strength formulas repeatedly divide by depth, frequency, delta, wave length, rI, sinh(kh), energy integrals, and directional sums without coherent range validation (for example lines 674-687, 803-811, 855-878, 1150-1160, 1264-1287, 1422-1427, 2046-2053, 2442-2450, and 2575-2576). Exact wkn==0 repairs at lines 1206, 1477, 1763, 1990, and 2593 occur only after the square-root/division expression and do not catch NaN or near-zero denominators.
